facts.statement: The Postal Chaos Alliance is the sworn enemy of all Postmen; its members steal and burn mail and packages to keep them from being delivered.
facts.quote: Whenever possible he steals mail and packages and burns them

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A SOE news post (captured January 2010) introducing the Postal Chaos Alliance (PCA), the secret enemy of the Postmen, led by Emahl. It describes the PCA camp's location south of the Tavern Cellar battle and says only top-level Postmen may fight Emahl's group.
